sources.snippet: AION Analytics (India), founded by Lokesh Gupta. Sovereign, language-and-context-aware AI for markets, citizens and developers, because models trained on global corpora fail at 50-kilometre scale. Methods published, failures published. Independent of Aion Analytics LLC (US) and AION Labs (Israel).

sources.snippet: Quantitative research terminal. Forecasts, dealer gamma, off-exchange blocks, insider buying, breadth and fundamentals across 1,337 tickers and 33 profiles.
